slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Protractor Postulate: the rays from a point on one side of a line can be matched with the numbers 0 to 180, so an angle's measure is the absolute value of the difference of its rays' numbers.

Angles are acute (less than 90 degrees), right (90), obtuse (between 90 and 180) or straight (180). Angle Addition Postulate: if point D is in the interior of angle ABC, then m angle ABD + m angle DBC = m angle ABC.
